── PROBLEMS FOUND (8) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1. ✗ Critical · Disks · /dev/sda
     Disk /dev/sda is failing: 24 sectors could not be read
     S.M.A.R.T. attribute 197 Current_Pending_Sector = 24 and 198 Offline_Uncorrectable = 24.
     Sectors that cannot be read mean data on them may already be lost, and the count usually grows
     quickly.
     → What to do: Back up the data now. Replace disk /dev/sda (serial ZC1234AB). If it is in a
       RAID, check the array has rebuilt before pulling the disk.
     Evidence:
       │ 197 Current_Pending_Sector  0x0012   100   100   000    Old_age   Always       -       24

     → What to do: Replace the disk.

  3. ✗ Critical · RAID & storage pools · md0
     RAID md0 is degraded [_U]: one member is missing
     /proc/mdstat shows [2/1] [_U].
     The array has no redundancy left.
     → What to do: Back up now, then replace the failed member and re-add it: mdadm --manage
       /dev/md0 --add /dev/sdX1
     Evidence:
       │ md0 : active raid1 sdb1[1]
       │       976630464 blocks super 1.2 [2/1] [_U]

  4. ✗ Critical · Power supply · PSU2
     Power supply PSU2 has failed (AC input lost)
     → What to do: Check the power cord and PDU of PSU2; if power is present, replace PSU2.

  5. ⚠ Warning · Memory (RAM) · DIMM_A1
     Corrected ECC errors on DIMM_A1 (152 in 7 days)
     EDAC reports corrected errors on one module. They are fixed by ECC but often precede
     uncorrectable errors.
     → What to do: Plan to replace DIMM_A1 at the next maintenance window. Run memtester or the
       vendor diagnostics to confirm.

  6. ⚠ Warning · Disks · <script>alert("x")</script>" onmouseover="alert(1)" '><img src=x onerror=a…

     onerror=alert(2)>

     → What to do: Reseat or replace the SATA/SAS cable and backplane slot.
